questions.question: According to a wise saying, what do the people do when wicked people rule over them?
What does a wise saying say a poor man and an oppressor have in common?

answers.text: The LORD gives light to the eyes of both
Both of them will stand before the king
Both of them live inside the same city

questions.question: A wise saying says a king who judges the poor fairly will have a throne that lasts only his lifetime. True or false?
According to a wise saying, what happens to the person who trusts in the LORD?

answers.text: He is set securely on high
He is given a seat by the king
